svg.text: Turn from 16 mm 316: an M12 x 1 nose 5 long, then a 14 dia

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: body 8 long with two spanner flats 12 across.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bore 5.4 through for the TO-46 photodiode can; counterbore

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the outer end to suit the can's flange.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The nose's end face is flat and smooth: it presses the 10 x 3

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: quartz sensor window onto a 0.5 mm EPDM washer in the boss.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fix the photodiode in the bore with UV-stable epoxy, window side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: facing the water. The amplifier (8 x 18 x 18) sits on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outer end; its lead runs to the enclosure gland.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Screw in by hand, then a quarter turn with a spanner.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no light leaks round the nose when held to a lamp.
